description: Allows retrieving information about available USB devices through lsusb.
examples:
- name: Get information about USB devices
  community.general.usb_facts:

- name: Print information about USB devices
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "On bus {{ item.bus }} device {{ item.device }} with id {{ item.id }} is {{ item.name }}"
  loop: "{{ ansible_facts.usb_devices }}"

return_values.name: usb_devices
return_values.description: A list of USB devices available. Returned: always

return_values.name: bus
return_values.description: The bus the usb device is connected to. Returned: always Sample: "001"

return_values.name: device
return_values.description: The device number occupied on the bus. Returned: always Sample: "002"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the USB device. Returned: always Sample: "1d6b:0002"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Human readable name of the device. Returned: always Sample: "Linux Foundation 2.0 root hub"
